rules.blocking: A blocking gate must be PASS before the next step (or the next job of the same kind) starts.
rules.approver: 'harness' = automatic QC by DuckDuckGoose; 'Owner' = explicit approval logged in STATUS.md with CEST time; 'harness + Owner' = harness check then Owner decision.
rules.default_external_actions: HOLD (never post/upload/send without explicit Owner order)
rules.check_type: code = deterministic script decides; judge = vision/LLM model decides under judge_policy; human = Owner decides (logged in STATUS with CEST time). 'assist' names the secondary check.

unit_prices.unit: Higgsfield app credits (ElevenLabs entries: ElevenLabs credits)

gates.name: Never post / upload / hand off
gates.check: No social post, publish, message, cloud upload or external send unless Owner explicitly ordered that specific action for that file (logged in STATUS with the time).
gates.fail_criteria: Any external post/upload/send/handoff without a logged explicit Owner order.

gates.name: QC first
gates.check: Everything shown to Owner (strip, mute, mix) has passed every AUTO gate of its step, with the QC table attached.
gates.fail_criteria: Material reaches Owner with a failing or unrun blocking gate.

gates.name: Balance preflight
gates.check: Read the Higgsfield (or ElevenLabs) balance before a round.
gates.fail_criteria: balance < round_budget + 100, or balance unknown.

gates.name: Budget line stop
gates.check: Track spend per budget line and per round.
gates.fail_criteria: Spend reaches 80% of a line/round cap without a stop+report; any spend beyond 100% without Owner; episode total above its hard cap.
gates.assist: Owner decides any spend beyond 100% of a line or above the cap

gates.name: Retry caps / surgical regen
gates.check: Count attempts per shot per round; regenerate only failed shot IDs.
gates.fail_criteria: > 2 draft retries in first-pass QC; > 1 paid retry per shot in a revision round; > 3 attempts on a high-risk video; whole-chain regen for a single-shot note.

gates.name: Draft-first / finals only on approval
gates.check: Finals (2k stills, Seedance finalize) are created only for Owner-approved shots; no video before strip approval.
gates.fail_criteria: Any final or video job for a shot without the required approval.

gates.name: Ledger + reconciliation
gates.check: Every job logged with id, model, tier, cost, verdict, used/unused; STATUS has balance before/after; ledger reconciled with the account after timeouts.
gates.fail_criteria: Unlogged job; ledger total != account delta.

gates.name: Reserve draws reported
gates.check: Any move of credits between lines or reserve draw is reported to Owner before spending.
gates.fail_criteria: Reserve spent without a report/approval.
gates.assist: code (default-deny on any reserve draw / line move)

gates.name: Bible + refs loaded
gates.check: Episode folder created; the series refs (world plates, locked character sheets, logo) listed with valid media ids (re-upload if rejected).
gates.fail_criteria: Any required ref missing or unresolvable.

gates.name: Character roles follow the show bible
gates.check: Every beat-map row gives each recurring character a role the show bible allows; no character is placed in a group, place or action the bible excludes for its role.
gates.fail_criteria: Any shot with a character in a role, group or place the bible excludes.

items: 1 Each recurring character's role per row is one the bible allows
2 No character is inside a group, place or action the bible excludes for its role
3 Role-bound props appear only where the bible places them

gates.name: One world / STYLE-LOCK plan
gates.check: Every present-day location is mapped to a world plate/series ref; only flashbacks and earlier-period scenes are exempt.
gates.fail_criteria: A present-day location with no world source, or a look from another place.

gates.name: Natural motion + individuality in templates
gates.check: Every character prompt template carries the show's movement and handling clauses and individual-timing wording.
gates.fail_criteria: Template lacks the movement/handling clause or allows synced action or handling the show bible excludes.

gates.name: Pick 1 of 3 pitches
gates.check: PITCHES.md with 3 storylines (cast, logline, want, climax, each recurring character's role, the fact the story rests on, set feasibility).
gates.fail_criteria: Fewer than 3 pitches or no Owner pick logged.

gates.name: One-page brief
gates.check: BRIEF.md: logline, character roles, cast table, climax, ending, VO outline, rules, open questions with defaults.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing section or > 1 page of core brief.

gates.name: Beat map locked with transitions
gates.check: BEATMAP.md row per shot: length, gen length, model, WET/DRY tag, who+count, character roles, action in/out, trajectory for grabs, transition to next, TOD, props; function-only location words; Owner lock + open questions answered.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing transition/trajectory/model/tag; décor words in location descriptions; no Owner lock.
gates.assist: code (row completeness + décor-word lint) before Owner

gates.name: Ending template
gates.check: Last scene continues under the locked end logo per the show's ending spec (width, fade-in, visible time); the ending beats follow the bible's order.
gates.fail_criteria: Separate end plate, extra figures in the fade, wrong logo spec, ending beats out of order.

gates.name: Time-of-day lock
gates.check: TOD per block with sky/light cues and anti-drift lines; written into every prompt.
gates.fail_criteria: Shot without TOD or prompt without sky/light state.

gates.name: Height/scale board
gates.check: Numeric ratio board built locally (the scale reference at 1.00x, every character's height ratio, set pieces); attached or heights stated in prompt.
gates.fail_criteria: No board; ratios missing from multi-character prompts.

gates.name: Per-room continuity sheet
gates.check: CONTINUITY.md: STYLE-LOCK block, location master per location, fixed props with counts, prop chains, costume, wet/dry, character presence, geography (L/R, launch points).
gates.fail_criteria: Location without master or prop counts; prop chain gaps.

gates.name: Credit plan
gates.check: CREDIT-PLAN.md lines with budget and 80% stop; totals within the episode target/cap.
gates.fail_criteria: Plan over cap or lines without stops.

gates.name: New identity refs approved
gates.check: New character sheets (head sheets, turnarounds), location masters (with a vs-world sheet) and character variants pass the drift/height check and Owner approval.
gates.fail_criteria: Drafts use a ref that isn't approved or fails the world match.

gates.name: Character drift gate
gates.check: Side-by-side crop per character per still against its locked sheet (stills/qc/drift/<SHOT>-<char>.jpg); MATCH/DRIFT verdict logged.
gates.fail_criteria: Any DRIFT (hair or head-feature colour, texture or size; eyewear; body shape; costume).

items: 1 Hair/head-feature colour matches the locked sheet
2 Hair/head-feature texture + size match (not only shape)
3 Eyewear/accessories present and identical
4 Body shape/proportions match
5 Costume items present per CONTINUITY
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass on every character; any fail = DRIFT

gates.name: Locked character identity gate
gates.check: Crop of each locked character vs its locked sheet (master + head sheet).
gates.fail_criteria: A locked character's identity signs differ from its sheet (face, hair, build, apparel, accessories), or it is too small to read when acting.
gates.when: every still with a locked character

gates.name: Headcount
gates.check: Count the figures in frame vs the beat map.
gates.fail_criteria: Extra or missing figure; a second copy of a locked character; phantom.

gates.name: Height/scale
gates.check: Measure ratios vs board.
gates.fail_criteria: > 10% off; size morph between shots.

gates.name: STYLE-LOCK / background drift (still)
gates.check: Side-by-side vs series refs; banned list; >= 2 series signatures (the show's STYLE-LOCK signature list).
gates.fail_criteria: Any banned element (any item on the project STYLE-LOCK banned-decor list); < 2 signatures; reads as another place. Exempt: flashback/earlier-period shots.

items: 1 No banned element (list in fail_criteria) anywhere in frame
2 >= 2 series signatures visible (the show's STYLE-LOCK signature list)
3 Materials/palette read as the same world as the refs, not another location
4 Location geometry matches its location master
5 Lighting is consistent with the TOD lock
rubric.pass_rule: items 1-3 must pass; 4-5 fail -> WATCH with crop. Flashback/earlier-period shots exempt.

gates.name: Props and counts
gates.check: Compare to continuity sheet.
gates.fail_criteria: Prop added/lost/moved; wrong count; story prop early (e.g. key on desk before hand-off); wrong story prop.

gates.name: Side / screen-direction continuity
gates.check: LEFT/RIGHT of each character vs neighbouring shots.
gates.fail_criteria: Unmotivated side swap across a cut.

gates.name: Natural pose
gates.check: Pose/handling check against the show bible.
gates.fail_criteria: A stance or handling the show bible excludes; synced group pose.

items: 1 Each character's stance is one the bible gives its body
2 Objects are held or carried only the way the bible allows
3 Group poses not synchronised (individual timing/pose)
refs: approved finals of the same location

gates.name: Treadmill rule (staging)
gates.check: Runs drafted as START + END frames, same locked camera, opposite sides.
gates.fail_criteria: Single-frame run; planned travel < 40% frame width.

gates.name: Leap / hand-off path
gates.check: Launch -> contact -> landing as 3 frames from the same camera; contact on the arc; depth plausible.
gates.fail_criteria: Contact off path; object behind another character; mid-action start frame.

gates.name: Edit-order stills strip approval
gates.check: Strip of every still in edit order with beat text, character roles, TOD, per-cut transition notes, QC verdicts, open notes.
gates.fail_criteria: No strip, or video started before Owner approval.

gates.name: Wet / water realism (still)
gates.check: Wet props heavy/dark/sagging; refraction, caustics, ripples, steam; wet hair and cloth; underwater particles + blue falloff.
gates.fail_criteria: Dry-balloon wet props; glassy CGI water; no depth.

items: 1 Wet props read heavy: dark, sagging (not dry balloons)
2 Water shows refraction and/or caustics and ripples
3 Steam present where the water is hot
4 Wet hair, cloth and surfaces clump and darken
5 Underwater: particles + blue depth falloff
6 Water is not glassy/CGI-smooth
refs: approved wet finals of the series

gates.name: TOD match
gates.check: Sky/light vs TOD lock.
gates.fail_criteria: Wrong TOD block.

gates.name: Final-res check
gates.check: 2k final matches approved draft 1:1; textures; small props legible; clean faces; no garbled text.
gates.fail_criteria: Any composition/prop difference; illegible story prop; melted features.

items: 1 Composition matches the approved draft 1:1 (same framing, positions, counts)
2 Small story props legible
3 Faces/eyes clean, no melted features
4 No garbled text/glyphs
5 Textures at 2k detail
rubric.precheck: code: SSIM of a 512-px downscale vs the approved draft; flag < 0.6 for the judge (uncalibrated; log values on the first episode)
refs: approved draft of the same shot

gates.assist: code (SSIM pre-check vs approved draft; uncalibrated)

gates.name: Model routing
gates.check: WET/MUD/POOL/SOAK/UNDERWATER/splash -> Kling 3.0 pro (sound off, 1.5 cr/s); dry identity-critical/hand-off -> Seedance 2.5 480p draft then finalize/upscale, always with declined_preset_id 24bae836-2c4a-48e0-89b6-49fcc0b21612.
gates.fail_criteria: Wet shot sent to Seedance; Seedance job without declined_preset_id; >1 rephrase on a blocked dry Seedance job before switching to Kling.

gates.name: First/mid/last frame gate
gates.check: Frame 0/mid/end sheet (+ full-fps for high-risk); first frame matches start still.
gates.fail_criteria: Doesn't start on the still; headcount change; prop appears/vanishes; morph; hidden cut/teleport.

gates.name: Locked character identity gate in motion
gates.check: Crop of each locked character at first/mid/last vs its locked sheet.
gates.fail_criteria: Any G2.03 failure at any of the three frames.
gates.when: every clip with a locked character

thresholds.frames: 0, duration/2, last decoded; plus in/mid/out of the used window if picks trims; every 0.5 s for high-risk clips

rubric.see: G4.02 scoring applied at first/mid/last (+ used-window frames)

gates.assist: code (figure count, height fraction, frame sampling)

gates.name: Background drift / no timelapse sky
gates.check: bgdrift.py on first/mid/last (sky band top 30%, side bands 12%) + eyeball top third t0 vs tend.
gates.fail_criteria: DRIFT (sky >= 14 or sides >= 18) not explained by subject or scripted camera move; new background features; timelapse clouds.

items: 1 Drift is localised where the subject moves (body/splash/steam), or the scripted camera move explains it (push-in raises side drift evenly)
2 Sky band shows no cloud travel / timelapse between t0 and tend
3 No new background feature appears (waterfall, dome, building)
4 Fixed geometry (rails, domes, roofline) keeps its shape
rubric.pass_rule: DRIFT/watch passes only if 1 and 2-4 all pass; otherwise FAIL
refs: a push-in that raises side drift evenly, explained by the camera move -> PASS

gates.assist: judge (is a DRIFT/watch explained by subject motion or the scripted camera move? rubric)

gates.name: Natural motion
gates.check: Movement/handling/individual timing over the used window.
gates.fail_criteria: A movement the show bible excludes for the character's body inside the used window; synced motion; cartoon motion unless the bible asks for it.

items: 1 Each character moves the way the bible gives its body inside the used window
2 Individual timing, no synced motion
3 No cartoon motion unless the bible asks for it
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass inside the used window

gates.name: No Ken Burns / no stiffness / no static fills
gates.check: Per-clip frame-motion metric over the used window (stillgate thresholds, see G4.10) + freezedetect; vgate local p90 as a stiffness hint; no pan/zoom over stills; blocked shots rerouted, not filled.
gates.fail_criteria: peak_fd < 3.0 AND mean_fd < 0.15 over the used window (still-only); Ken Burns; frozen bodies (local p90 far below neighbours, judged on WATCH); static hold used as a fill.

thresholds.stiffness_hint: local p90 far below its neighbours -> WATCH, judge
thresholds.note: per-clip version of G4.10 over the used window

gates.name: Treadmill rule (motion)
gates.check: Runner screen position across the clip.
gates.fail_criteria: < 40% frame-width travel and no background parallax.

gates.name: Spatial logic
gates.check: Launch point = last seen position; path on arc.
gates.fail_criteria: Character relocates to a new launch point; teleport between shots.

gates.name: Wet realism in motion
gates.check: Water depth/refraction; heavy wet props; no standing in deep water.
gates.fail_criteria: Glassy water; dry-balloon props; character stands in deep water in the used window.

items: 1 Water keeps depth/refraction over the clip
2 Wet props stay heavy (no floating dry balloon)
3 No character stands up in deep water inside the used window
4 Ripples/splashes react to motion
5 Not glassy
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass in the used window
refs: approved wet finals of the series

gates.name: Edge extras
gates.check: Full-fps check of frame edges and doorways.
gates.fail_criteria: Any invented character (a phantom figure, a stranger walking in).

gates.name: Per-cut QC
gates.check: Last frame A vs first frame B for every cut: props/counts, holder, costume, wet/dry, TOD, geometry, LEFT/RIGHT, headcount; hand-offs one at a time. Table in STATUS.
gates.fail_criteria: Any unexplained continuity break at a cut.

gates.name: Locked character contact sheet
gates.check: One crop per locked character per shot next to its locked sheet, built per mute.
gates.fail_criteria: Any major drift (fix before delivery); minor drift not reported with crops.

signs: a face or head shape differs from the sheet
b hair or head features differ (colour, shape, size)
d apparel or accessories differ from the locked version
e too small to read (code measures; < 0.12 frame height when acting)
scoring.score: 0 on-model / 1 minor / 2 drift per sign, with confidence and one-line evidence

rubric.major: any sign = 2, OR apparel mismatch, OR sum of minors >= 3 across the frame set -> regenerate before delivery
rubric.pass_rule: no major in the mute; every minor listed with crops

gates.name: STYLE-LOCK audit
gates.check: One mid-frame per shot vs series refs; list pre-style-lock shots still in the timeline.
gates.fail_criteria: Banned element or pre-style-lock shot left without a redo plan.

gates.name: Technical mute check
gates.check: freezedetect n=0.0008 d=0.5 none; blackdetect none; no audio stream; 1080x1920 24 fps; dissolves + logo frames checked; runtime as planned.
gates.fail_criteria: Any detection or wrong format.

gates.name: Flashback treatment
gates.check: Memory/past graded warm faded film (lifted blacks, lower contrast, warm, ~0.7 sat, soft blur, vignette, grain); colour returns through the dissolve.
gates.fail_criteria: Flashback ungraded or present-day graded.

gates.name: Cut-for-story review
gates.check: Flag shots that read inconsistently (a character off-model, the wrong character, ghosts) or don't move the story; propose cuts; re-check neighbouring cuts and VO references.
gates.fail_criteria: Known-inconsistent shot left in without flag; cut leaves a dangling reference.

flag_triggers: the wrong character, not fixable cheaply
rubric.note: human gate: harness proposes, Owner decides

gates.name: Review copy <= 30 MB
gates.check: 720x1280 2-pass x264 ~1.7 Mb/s + 2 fps sheet.
gates.fail_criteria: Size > 30 MB or duration mismatch.

gates.name: Owner mute review
gates.check: Owner notes logged verbatim with CEST time; fixes surgical; re-QC.
gates.fail_criteria: Notes not logged or fixed without re-QC.

gates.name: Picture lock
gates.check: Owner picture-locks the mute; after lock no picture change without Owner reopening (new version).
gates.fail_criteria: Audio work before lock; picture altered after lock.

gates.name: No still-only shots (frame-motion gate)
gates.check: Per-shot consecutive-frame |diff| on every mute AND on every final picture (re-run on the nosubs master before G6.09 and on the delivery file at G7.01). Decode at 180x320 grey; shot boundaries from the stitch manifest/EDL; dissolve overlaps excluded. mean_fd = mean |diff| (0-255); peak_fd = median over frames of the 99.5th-percentile |diff|. Writes <mute>-stillgate.json next to the QC artifacts.
gates.fail_criteria: FAIL (still-only): peak_fd < 3.0 AND mean_fd < 0.15 -> route the shot back to Step 3 (re-animate from the SAME approved still at the SAME duration, prompt names continuous ambient motion; never 'nothing else moves'). WATCH: peak_fd < 6.0 OR mean_fd < 0.25 -> judge on a frame sheet; PASS only if real motion is visible.
gates.when: every mute + every final picture (Owner rule 2026-10-04 22:21 CEST)

thresholds.peak_stat: median over frames of per-frame p99.5 |diff|
thresholds.exclude: dissolve overlap frames + 1 frame at each boundary

calibration.note: calibrate on known still-only and moving shots before the first episode: a known still must FAIL, a moving mute must have no FAIL

gates.name: Script lock: Owner approves the placed script before any audio
gates.check: VO-SCRIPT.md (per shot, every delivered language, in/out on locked picture) + timing JSON + draft SRT exist, AND Owner approval is logged in STATUS with the time. Conditional approvals ("OK if timing checks out"): the condition is checked by code and the result logged before any generation.
gates.fail_criteria: Any ElevenLabs VO/music/SFX credit spent before the logged approval, or with an unchecked condition; script files missing.

gates.name: VO style checklist
gates.check: The show's VO style checklist (voice, register, opening and sign-off lines from the show bible); climax lines in gaps (>= 0.3 s after hit, >= 0.4 s before next); no VO in cold open/flashback or logo fade-in; the bible's speech rate; >= 0.4 s between lines; every line matches on-screen action.
gates.fail_criteria: Any checklist item missing or violated.
gates.assist: code (gap/timing asserts, protected windows, mora rate)

gates.name: VO voice settings
gates.check: ElevenLabs project voice (voice id from the project handbook), eleven_v3, the handbook's style tags and atempo, peaks -2 dBFS; every line ASR-checked; pickups RMS-matched.
gates.fail_criteria: Other voice/model/tags; unchecked line; pickup level mismatch > 1 dB.

gates.name: Music approach
gates.check: ElevenLabs Music, instrumental score shaped to beats; ONE take by default; automation for beats; music lowered -4 dB under VO (climax -7), floor -9, never gated; cadence resolves under the logo.
gates.fail_criteria: Second take without Owner OK; vocals the show bible does not ask for; gated dropouts.
gates.assist: judge (instrumental unless the bible asks for vocals, cadence under the logo)

gates.name: SFX / character sounds / water
gates.check: Real sounds for every sound source; character vocal sounds sparing; each water shot has its own layered distinct real water sound; no loops; beds lowered -3 dB (-5 climax); de-buzzed.
gates.fail_criteria: Generic/looped water bed; key beats without their sources' sounds; character sounds under the end watermark other than the sign-off.

items: 1 Each water shot has its own distinct layered real water sound (no shared bed across shots)
2 No audible loop/repeat within a shot (autocorrelation pre-check flags period < shot length)
3 Key beats carry the real sounds of their sources
4 Character vocal sounds sparing; nothing under the end watermark but the sign-off
5 No 50 Hz buzz
rubric.precheck: code: cue table one water cue per wet shot; loop autocorrelation

gates.assist: judge (water distinct per shot, no loop; rubric)

gates.name: Tagger sanity
gates.check: PANNs tags judged on stem + full mix with window-edge awareness.
gates.fail_criteria: Take accepted/rejected on a solo short-window tag alone; a take whose sound does not fit its source kept.

gates.name: Builder asserts
gates.check: No VO in protected windows; climax lines start >= 0.3 s after a hit ends and end >= 0.4 s before the next hit; line gap >= 0.4 s; last line ends <= T-0.3 s; subs = VO +/- 5 ms.
gates.fail_criteria: Any assert fails.

gates.name: Loudness target
gates.check: ebur128 on the master and on every AAC copy (review, delivery): integrated -12.5 +/- 0.5 LUFS, LRA ~7-9 LU, TP <= -0.3 dBTP; limiter alimiter 0.86 level=disabled.
gates.fail_criteria: Integrated outside -12.5 +/- 0.5 LUFS; true peak > -0.3 dBTP on master or review copy.

gates.name: Picture untouched
gates.check: No-subs video stream MD5 equals locked mute.
gates.fail_criteria: MD5 mismatch.

gates.name: Subtitles
gates.check: Subtitles in the show's locked style (font, size, colours, outline, margin); max 2 lines; SRT too.
gates.fail_criteria: Different style/colour; > 2 lines; auto captions.

gates.name: Outputs + QC doc
gates.check: final mp4 (subs), nosubs, review <= 30 MB, stems, subs, cues JSON, audio ledger, QC md with loudness vs the target and open points.
gates.fail_criteria: Any output missing.

gates.name: Owner mix approval / episode lock
gates.check: Owner approves or locks; notes -> pickups only, reuse stems.
gates.fail_criteria: Delivery before lock.

gates.name: Delivery copy encode
gates.check: 1080x1920 2-pass x264 (~3.0-3.1 Mb/s) + AAC 160-192k encoded from the mix WAV (never AAC->AAC); size < 50 MB (aim <= 48); true peak <= -0.3 dBTP; G4.10 re-run on the file.
gates.fail_criteria: Size >= 50 MB; TP over; duration mismatch.

thresholds.audio_source: encode from the mix WAV, never AAC->AAC

gates.name: Upload (only on order)
gates.check: Upload to the Owner's delivery folder as 'EpNN - <Title> (final).mp4' only when Owner orders it; link logged.
gates.fail_criteria: Upload without explicit order; wrong folder/name.

gates.name: Handoff (never post)
gates.check: Package (final, nosubs, review, title, logline, the project handle, Owner-set priority) prepared; sent only on Owner go; nobody posts without the lock.
gates.fail_criteria: Handoff sent without Owner go; any post.

gates.name: Lock record + lessons
gates.check: LOCKED block in STATUS (files, CEST time, never posted); CREDIT-PLAN closed; lessons appended to PIPELINE-LESSONS + handbook.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing lock record or credit close-out.

changelog: 1.1-neutral (2026-11-23): the gate policy a show gets when it names none (docs/SHOW-PROFILE.md): the demo policy's gate ids, steps, blocking, approvers and check types, with every check written for any cast and any world; budgets keep only the provider unit prices.

judge_policy.verdict: keep the worse of the two runs
judge_policy.on_escalate: fail closed -> human (Owner sees the crop)
judge_policy.output: JSON per rubric item: pass|fail, confidence, one-line evidence
judge_policy.calibration: before the first episode on known fails/passes; 100% recall on known fails, <= 15% false fails
judge_policy.spend: judge model cost is NOT in any Higgsfield/ElevenLabs line; log it separately (open question to Owner)
